Tap your feet to this classic peppy melodious romantic Hindi song 'Kaise Dekha Hai Mujhe Ji O' sung by Manna Dey & Asha Bhosle from the superhit Bollywood blockbuster romantic comedy family drama movie 'Pati Patni' (1966). Music composed by R.D. Burman. Lyrics by Anand Bakshi. Cast: Sanjeev Kumar, Nanda, Mehmood, Mumtaz, Sujit Kumar, Shashikala, Om Prakash, Johnny Walker, Leela Mishra. Directed by S.A. Akbar.
